set.body: Follow-up to bd-01M2EEVF9EPRH4DMTEVE2934YW. Continuous boundary-cell extension repairs C04 r23/r24 endpoint topology under unchanged interior gates, but r24 residual inverse whole-field maximum is 8.0862 mm and endpoint round-trip maxima are about 4.65/4.63 mm. Original whole-field residual inverse max was 5.0426 mm under identity extension. Interior maximum stays 0.0608 mm under the frozen 0.2 mm limit. Assess a declared whole-boundary inverse contract and numerical method without masking samples or loosening thresholds; retain original and follow-up evidence in docs/benchmarks/halfflow-export-topology-diagnosis.md.
set.title: HalfFlow: qualify inverse accuracy over the full export boundary
